readme.markdown:
# BotFactory MCP Farm

Hosted MCP servers on [MCPize](https://mcpize.com) — zero-auth public APIs, freemium x402 (USDC on Base).

## Catalog

See [CATALOG.md](./CATALOG.md) for the full list with gateway URLs.

## Connect

```
https://<slug>.mcpize.run/mcp
```

Requires an x402-capable MCP client for paid tools. `health_check` and discovery tools are free.

## Awesome list entries

See [AWESOME_ENTRIES.md](./AWESOME_ENTRIES.md).

toolsPreview.name: detect_language
toolsPreview.description:
Detect language of text using character frequency analysis.
    Returns: {language, confidence, method}

toolsPreview.name: analyze_sentiment
toolsPreview.description:
Analyze sentiment of text (positive/negative/neutral).
    Returns: {score, label, confidence}

toolsPreview.name: extract_keywords
toolsPreview.description:
Extract top keywords from text using TF scoring.
    Returns: {keywords: [{word, score}], total_words}

toolsPreview.name: find_duplicates
toolsPreview.description:
Find duplicate or near-duplicate texts using Jaccard similarity.
    Returns: {duplicates: [{text1_idx, text2_idx, similarity}]}

toolsPreview.name: summarize_text
toolsPreview.description:
Extractive summarization — picks most important sentences.
    Returns: {summary, sentences_used, original_length}
